digest.component_or_area: LLM step failure recording and reporting across gates
propositions: LLM step failures that do not fail the run must be tallied and reported on the code-review verdict under coverage.llm_step_failures
LLM step failures must be tallied and reported on the completion verdict under coverage.llm_step_failures with the coverage object present only when non-empty
The code-review and verify-completion run scopes must activate the step-failure sink via collect_step_failures() so failures are recorded
Clean runs must not include empty coverage objects: code-review verdicts omit llm_step_failures when absent, completion verdicts omit coverage entirely when absent
The step-failure tally shape {total, by_step} must be declared identically in both code_review_verdict and completion_verdict schemas with required fields and integer minimums
